bugs.title: Password reset email not delivered for Gmail accounts
bugs.desc: Users with @gmail.com addresses report never receiving the password reset link. Hotmail and Outlook work fine. Likely an SPF/DKIM issue with our mail provider.

bugs.title: Payment summary shows incorrect total when discount code applied
bugs.desc: Applying a 20% discount code causes the order summary to display the pre-discount amount. The charge itself is correct — only the UI is wrong. Reproducible on all browsers.

bugs.title: API rate limit returns 500 instead of 429
bugs.desc: When a client exceeds the rate limit threshold the server throws a 500 Internal Server Error rather than the expected 429 Too Many Requests. This breaks client-side retry logic.

bugs.title: Dark mode toggle state not persisted on page refresh
bugs.desc: User preference for dark mode resets to light on every page reload. localStorage key is being set but not read correctly on init.
